most_similar_reason: Candidate 6 shares the core plot almost point for point: a supreme god angered by human wickedness sends a world-destroying flood, a forewarned righteous hero builds a wooden vessel and provisions it, he and his family survive the waters, give thanks/offerings on emerging, and repopulate the earth so that later peoples and nations descend from him.
least_similar_reason: Candidate 4 is not a narrative at all but a lexical-theological note on a term for a diffuse 'Great Spirit,' with no hero, flood, vessel, repopulation, or any sequence of events to compare.
